note: Forested Ozark ridges east of Pineville, reached by area roads off Route K. Seven small primitive camping spots are marked on the area map, most beside parking lots on the area roads under the oaks; no pads or site lengths are published, so a 23-ft rig may find them tight. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with a caveat: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted in spots designated on the area map'; map (2021) shows 7 'Primitive Camping' spots, matching GIS 27. Rule 140 is the standard text but ends with a bare 'Camping is prohibited.' line (flagged). No permit-only rule, no Rule 101. Pin = GIS 300; kept. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Phone matches the area page.
flags: RULE 140 ODDITY: the area page's Rule 140 is the standard text (14 days in 30, quiet hours) followed by a bare 'Camping is prohibited.' line with no qualifier. Read as a page artifact, as with 13911 Bootleg Access: the same page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' under Things to Do, the brochure (2024-06) says 'Primitive camping is permitted in spots designated on the area map', and the map shows 7 camping symbols. No 'special use permit only' wording. If AWH wants certainty, the area phone (417) 895-6880 would settle it.

INCLUSION/FIT (caveat): 7 primitive spots, most beside small parking lots on MDC improved roads. Leaf-off imagery at GIS 300 and 301 shows forest with small road-edge pull-offs at the lots and no visible pads; the camping points sit 60-80 m off the road under canopy. Drive-in by road, padless; fit for a 23-ft rig not verifiable from imagery. Stays with the caveat in the note (padless roadside camping rule).
HORSES: 17.3 miles of multi-use trails open to horses; MDC shows no horse camp, and none of the 7 spots is marked equestrian. Pin is not on an equestrian-only camp.

PIN: stored 36.58868,-94.33282 = GIS 300, the SW spot by lot 1856 (68 m) on the area road; a faint lane runs east from the road there toward a food-plot clearing. Kept; no single spot is clearly better from imagery.

CLUSTERS: 7 GIS points over ~3 km in three tracts (two in the NE tract off a separate road from Route K, ~3 km from the pin). Each is a single primitive spot; no split proposed. near.py: no other entry within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): upland forest, no water body.
PHONE: stored (417) 895-6880 matches the area page. The brochure lists the Cassville office (417) 847-5949; not stored.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row (not written per entry).
